context: Predicate-only Optional coverage from the real cleanup: when no value needs to be returned or passed on, filter(...).isPresent() or map(...).orElse(false) is clearer than opening the Optional value.

checklist.name: Creates revised check class
checklist.description: Creates CustomerSessionCheck.java with the requested import, class, and belongsToCustomer method.

checklist.name: Uses predicate-only Optional boundary
checklist.description: Uses sessionCustomerId.filter(id -> id.equals(expectedCustomerId)).isPresent(), map(id -> id.equals(expectedCustomerId)).orElse(false), or an equivalent direct Optional predicate boundary that calls equals on the present value.

checklist.name: Avoids value-read antipattern
checklist.description: Does not keep isPresent() followed by orElseThrow(), get(), or another value read for the customer id.

checklist.name: Preserves true behavior
checklist.description: Returns true when sessionCustomerId is present and equals expectedCustomerId.

checklist.name: Preserves false behavior
checklist.description: Returns false when sessionCustomerId is empty or does not equal expectedCustomerId.

checklist.name: Avoids null/list workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over the Optional.
